manifest.name: dsh-netxops
manifest.description: Network operations, topology and monitoring for DeepSeek Harness.

scripts.bundle: bun run scripts/build-host.mjs && bun run scripts/build-client.mjs

bundle.text:
# Host-only bundle patch (web-safe).
# Netx Ops is composed from the running Host's standard preset and synced into
# that Host profile's cordis.patch.yml at activation.

# Host-plane Netx Ops bridge: settings + credentials → connection publish.
# Ops-scoped `netx__*` tools mount from the agent preset (`dsh-netxops/tools`).
# Capability groups: ops + biz-monitor in Netx Ops by default; topology off.
# Tools and corresponding skills share the selected publication targets.
#
# IM + cron are separate profile bundles (pnpm blockExoticSubdeps forbids
# github: packages as transitive deps of this package). Install them only when
# their delivery or scheduling features are needed — see docs/INSTALL.md.
#
# After install, open Settings → Plugins to edit apiUrl / lang / thinking+reply
# language / groups (settings card client half; see docs/INSTALL.md).
# Token: credential NETX_API_TOKEN. Model language is Host-global (all presets).

- insert:
    - id: netxops
      name: dsh-netxops
      config:
        toolsEnabled: true
        groupOpsPresets: ''
        groupTopologyPresets: ''
        groupBizMonitorPresets: ''
        groupKbPresets: ''
        apiUrl: http://127.0.0.1:8890
        lang: zh
        thinkingLanguage: auto
        replyLanguage: follow-user
        nmsProvider: zte-ume
        tokenCredentialRef: NETX_API_TOKEN
        toolCallTimeoutMs: 120000
        installAgentPreset: true
        alarmPushEnabled: false
        alarmDeliverDsh: true
        alarmDeliverIm: false
        imBotId: ''
        imTargetId: ''
        imTargets: ''
        groupOpsInPreset: true
        groupOpsPublic: false
        groupTopologyInPreset: false
        groupTopologyPublic: false
        groupBizMonitorInPreset: true
        groupBizMonitorPublic: false
        kbRoot: ''
        groupKbInPreset: true
        groupKbPublic: false

readme.text: Network operations, topology and business monitoring tools for DeepSeek Harness Desktop and Web. Publish tools and their skills to Netx Ops, selected presets, or all presets; revoke them at any time.

In Harness **Plugins → Add plugin**, enter `github:hansjone/netxops`, or the absolute path to a released `dsh-netxops-<version>.tgz`. A release tarball is recommended for a fixed, tested version and avoids downloading from GitHub during installation.

For the Web CLI:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:hansjone/netxops
dsh web
```

Only Netx Ops is required. IM delivery and scheduling are optional, separate plugins. Users do not need Bun, Python, a local source checkout, or a build step; runtime JS and skills are included. Harness supplies its own internal packages and React.

See the [installation and troubleshooting guide](docs/INSTALL.md).

1. Open **Settings → Plugins → Netx Ops** and enter your Netx API URL and token.
2. Choose each capability group's target presets. The default enables operations and business monitoring in Netx Ops only; topology and publication to all presets start disabled.
3. After installation or upgrade, restart the relevant Desktop or Web Host once and select **Netx Ops** for a new session.

Publication switches and preset selection save automatically. Connection fields, model language, alarm settings and manually entered knowledge-base paths use **Save / Discard**, shown when a draft changes. Choosing a knowledge-base directory through the picker saves that path automatically.

The master publication switch removes all plugin-managed Netx tools and skills while retaining selections. Subsequent publication changes apply on the next model request without restarting. API access requires a reachable Netx service and token permissions matching the requested tools.

Optional features include alarm delivery to a Harness session or IM, knowledge-base skills and local memory, and downloading this Host's persisted sessions as a ZIP. See [knowledge-base configuration](docs/KNOWLEDGE_BASE.md) and the [tool map](docs/TOOL_MAP.md).

```sh
pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --ignore-scripts
bun run bundle
bun run release:check
bun run test:release

Development requires Node.js 22, pnpm 11.7 and Bun 1.3.13 or later. Building and package installation tests use only public development dependencies. Full Harness integration tests and type checking additionally need a local Harness runtime; see [maintainer instructions](docs/RELEASING.md).

Release checks detect stale or missing bundles, undeclared runtime dependencies and invalid metadata. Tests install the actual npm tarball offline in an isolated profile. CI repeats the package checks on Windows, macOS and Linux.

Group skills (ops / topology / biz-monitor) are published by netx over `/mcp` `resources` and cached under `$DSH_HOME/netxops-mcp-skills/`. This package does not ship skill files. Operator-subset KB pack skills remain local (see [Knowledge base](docs/KNOWLEDGE_BASE.md)).

Implementation and UI validation details: [Chinese review](docs/PUBLICATION-REVIEW.zh.md).
